def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c]
            # A one-cell component is a stray marker; replace using orthogonal surroundings.
            if sum(0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and grid[y][x]==v for y,x in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)))==0:
                ns=[grid[y][x] for y,x in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)) if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w]
                if ns: out[r][c]=max(set(ns),key=ns.count)
    return out
PY
